scenario: When a new vendor replies to the onboarding email with a W-9 attachment, record the TIN status and tax classification in the vendor master Google Sheet, create the vendor in QuickBooks, and post a confirmation in #procurement.
rule_hooks: W-9 completeness checklist, 1099-eligible entity types

scenario: When a purchase request form submission lands in the procurement sheet, look up the requester's department budget owner and route the PO for approval in Slack, escalating to the CFO if the amount exceeds the threshold.
rule_hooks: approval matrix by amount and department

scenario: When a nightly inventory sync updates a SKU's on-hand quantity below its reorder point in the inventory sheet, draft a replenishment PO to the preferred supplier and notify the warehouse lead in Slack.
rule_hooks: reorder points, preferred supplier per SKU, MOQ

scenario: When a supplier emails that a shipment is delayed, update the expected delivery date on the open PO in the tracking sheet, flag affected customer orders in HubSpot, and alert the account managers.
rule_hooks: PO-to-order mapping, delay severity tiers

scenario: When a vendor's certificate of insurance expiration date in the compliance tracker comes within 30 days, email the vendor a renewal request and mark the vendor 'pending COI' so new POs are blocked.
rule_hooks: required coverage minimums, expiry lead-time window

scenario: When an employee submits a facilities ticket in Freshdesk tagged 'HVAC' or 'plumbing', assign it to the contracted service vendor for that building, email the vendor the work order, and set the SLA due date.
rule_hooks: building-to-vendor contract map, priority SLA table

scenario: When HR marks a candidate as 'offer accepted' in the hiring tracker, create an IT provisioning task in Asana for the laptop kit matching the role, reserve a desk in the seating sheet, and notify the IT channel.
rule_hooks: role-to-hardware kit standards, office seating availability

scenario: When a termination record with a last-day date appears in the HR sheet, create Jira tickets to revoke SaaS access per the employee's app list, schedule equipment return via email, and notify their manager.
rule_hooks: app access inventory, return-shipping policy by location

scenario: When a supplier invoice email arrives in the AP inbox, match it against the PO and receiving log; if quantities and prices match within tolerance, create the bill in Xero, otherwise open a discrepancy ticket and email the buyer.
rule_hooks: three-way match tolerance percentages

scenario: When the warehouse logs a receipt in the receiving sheet with fewer units than ordered, mark the PO line 'partially received', update backorder quantities, and email the supplier asking for a ship date on the remainder.
rule_hooks: partial-receipt handling policy, backorder rules

scenario: When a DocuSign envelope for a master services agreement is completed, update the vendor status to 'active' in Salesforce, store the contract end date and renewal notice period in the contract register, and announce in #procurement.
rule_hooks: contract type to activation steps, renewal notice periods

scenario: When a contract in the register reaches its cancellation-notice deadline minus 14 days, create a review task for the contract owner, pull current-year spend from QuickBooks into the task, and post a reminder in Slack.
rule_hooks: auto-renewal terms, spend thresholds requiring re-bid

scenario: When a calendar booking is created for a room already reserved by an executive or board event, move the lower-priority booking to an equivalent free room and email the organizer the new location.
rule_hooks: booking priority tiers, room capacity and equipment specs

scenario: When a new sales order in HubSpot contains a SKU with zero available stock, set the deal's fulfillment status to 'backordered', look up the next inbound PO date, and email the customer an estimated ship date.
rule_hooks: available-to-promise calculation, inbound PO schedule

scenario: When an employee requests a software license via the IT Zendesk form, check the license inventory sheet for free seats; assign one and update the sheet, or if none remain, route a purchase request to the app owner.
rule_hooks: seat inventory, approved-software catalog, per-seat cost limits

scenario: When the shipping coordinator receives carrier quote replies by email for an outbound load, log each quote in the freight sheet, select the lowest-cost carrier meeting the delivery window, and notify the carrier and the warehouse.
rule_hooks: approved carrier list, transit-time requirements

scenario: When a workplace incident form is submitted, log it in the OSHA incident register sheet, open a corrective-action task in Asana for the site manager, and alert the EHS lead in Slack if it involves lost work time.
rule_hooks: OSHA recordability criteria, severity classification

scenario: When a vendor emails requesting a change to their remittance bank details, place a payment hold on the vendor in QuickBooks, create a verification task requiring a callback to the phone on file, and alert the AP manager.
rule_hooks: payment-fraud verification policy, vendor contact of record

scenario: When a supplier emails a price-increase notice, compare the new unit prices against the contracted rates in the pricing sheet, flag lines exceeding the contractual cap, and create a negotiation task for the category buyer.
rule_hooks: contracted price caps, escalation clauses

scenario: When a Zendesk ticket is tagged 'P1 outage' for a core system, post an incident notice in #it-status, update the status page entry in the IT sheet, and create a Zoom bridge invite for the on-call responders.
rule_hooks: system criticality tiers, on-call rotation schedule

scenario: When a milestone task in Asana is moved past its due date on a client implementation project, update the project health column in the PMO tracker to amber or red and notify the sponsor by email.
rule_hooks: RAG thresholds by days slipped, sponsor directory

scenario: When an office manager posts a supply request in the #office-requests Slack channel, check the stock sheet, add items below par level to the weekly supply order draft, and reply with the expected delivery day.
rule_hooks: par levels, weekly order cutoff day

scenario: When a facility lease in the real-estate register reaches its renewal-option exercise window, pull headcount for that site from the HR sheet, create a decision task for the facilities director, and email the landlord contact acknowledging receipt of terms.
rule_hooks: lease option dates, space-per-headcount standards

scenario: When a lab or production instrument's calibration due date in the asset register falls within two weeks, schedule a service visit with the certified calibration vendor via calendar and mark the asset 'calibration scheduled'.
rule_hooks: calibration intervals, certified vendor per asset class

scenario: When a customer return request arrives in the helpdesk, check the order date and SKU against return policy, issue an RMA number in the returns sheet, email the customer a shipping label, and alert the warehouse to expect the return.
rule_hooks: return window, non-returnable SKU list

scenario: When a delivery is logged as late in the receiving sheet, update the supplier's on-time-delivery score in the scorecard and, if it drops below the contract threshold, open a corrective-action request email to the supplier.
rule_hooks: OTD score threshold, scorecard calculation method

scenario: When an employee submits a travel request form for a site visit, check fare and hotel estimates against the travel policy, route out-of-policy requests to the department head for approval in Slack, and add approved trips to the travel calendar.
rule_hooks: per-diem and fare class policy by destination

scenario: When an employee requests access to a restricted area (server room, warehouse cage) via the facilities form, verify required training completion in the training sheet, request manager approval, and create the badge-system task once approved.
rule_hooks: area access prerequisites, required training certificates

scenario: When an outbound order in the shipping sheet contains a SKU flagged as hazardous, attach the SDS from Drive to the shipment record, notify the certified shipper on duty, and hold the order until the DG declaration is logged.
rule_hooks: hazmat SKU classification, certified shipper roster

scenario: When a new bill is posted to QuickBooks against a department's cost center, recompute month-to-date spend versus budget in the budget sheet and alert the budget owner in Slack if spend exceeds 90% of the allocation.
rule_hooks: cost-center budgets, alert percentage thresholds

scenario: When a driver logs a mileage reading in the fleet sheet that crosses the vehicle's next service interval, book a slot at the contracted service shop via email, block the vehicle on the dispatch calendar, and notify the driver.
rule_hooks: service intervals by vehicle model, contracted shop per region

scenario: When a records-retention date passes for a closed project folder listed in the compliance register, create an IT ticket to archive or delete the files, notify the project owner, and log the disposition date.
rule_hooks: retention schedule by record type, legal hold list

scenario: When a venue emails a booking confirmation for an offsite event, record the deposit amount and due date in the events sheet, create the bill in Xero, and send calendar holds to the attendee list.
rule_hooks: deposit approval limits, event attendee lists

scenario: When a purchase request names a single vendor for a spend above the competitive-bid threshold, mark the request 'needs justification' in the procurement sheet and email the requester the sole-source justification template.
rule_hooks: competitive bidding thresholds, sole-source exemptions

scenario: When a cycle count entry in the inventory sheet differs from system quantity by more than the tolerance, create an investigation task for the warehouse supervisor, freeze the bin location, and notify inventory control.
rule_hooks: count variance tolerance by SKU value class

scenario: When a new vendor is added to the vendor master, check its name and country against the restricted-party list sheet; on a match, set its status to 'blocked', create a compliance review ticket, and notify legal.
rule_hooks: restricted-party list, embargoed country list

scenario: When a warehouse employee emails a sick call-out for today's shift, mark the absence in the shift schedule sheet, find qualified staff not exceeding weekly hour limits, and post an open-shift request to them in Slack.
rule_hooks: certification requirements per role, overtime hour caps

scenario: When a helpdesk ticket reports a hardware failure on a laptop, look up its serial in the asset register; if under warranty, open a manufacturer claim email and issue a loaner, otherwise route a replacement purchase request.
rule_hooks: warranty end dates, loaner pool and replacement policy

scenario: When the freight forwarder emails that an inbound container is held at customs, update the PO status to 'customs hold', create a task for the trade compliance specialist to supply missing documents, and notify affected buyers.
rule_hooks: required import documents by HS code, broker contacts

scenario: When a monitoring alert email reports a conference-room Zoom device offline, check the room calendar for meetings in the next two hours, create a high-priority IT ticket if any are booked, and email those meeting organizers with an alternate room.
rule_hooks: room equipment inventory, ticket priority by time-to-next-meeting

scenario: A department head submits a purchase requisition form; the agent looks up the GL/budget code in the budget sheet, rejects requisitions with an invalid or closed code back to the requester, and otherwise creates the draft PO in the procurement tool and notifies the buyer in Slack.
rule_hooks: chart of accounts, open budget codes

scenario: A buyer forwards a supplier quote by email; the agent records it in the sourcing sheet and, if the quote's validity date is already within 5 business days of the planned order date, emails the vendor to request a refreshed quote and flags the row.
rule_hooks: quote validity window, business-day calendar

scenario: A Slack request asks to buy an item from a non-contracted supplier; the agent checks the preferred-vendor catalog for an equivalent SKU and, if one exists under contract, replies with the catalog option and opens the request against that vendor instead.
rule_hooks: preferred vendor catalog, contract pricing

scenario: A vendor invoice arrives in QuickBooks with net-15 terms; the agent compares it to the master vendor record's contracted net-45 terms, corrects the bill due date, and emails AP and the vendor contact about the discrepancy.
rule_hooks: contracted payment terms per vendor

scenario: A new bill is entered in Xero with 2/10 net 30 terms; the agent checks the cash-position sheet and, if the balance is above the treasury floor, schedules payment within the discount window and notifies the controller.
rule_hooks: discount terms, minimum cash threshold

scenario: A new supplier invoice includes sales tax on items the company buys for resale; the agent looks up the state resale certificate in Drive, emails it to the vendor's billing contact, and puts the bill on hold pending a corrected invoice.
rule_hooks: state tax exemption certificates, resale item classes

scenario: An invoice PDF lands in the AP inbox; the agent checks the bills ledger for the same vendor with matching invoice number or same amount within 30 days, holds a suspected duplicate, and posts the match to the AP Slack channel.
rule_hooks: duplicate matching criteria, lookback window

scenario: A supplier emails a recall notice listing affected lot numbers; the agent finds those lots in the inventory sheet, marks them quarantined, lists open customer orders allocated from them, and alerts the warehouse lead and customer service.
rule_hooks: lot traceability, quarantine status codes

scenario: The nightly inventory export shows a batch within 60 days of expiry; the agent tags it for priority picking in the WMS sheet, creates a task for the warehouse team, and notifies sales of discount-eligible stock.
rule_hooks: shelf-life thresholds by product class

scenario: A sales order over $25k is created in HubSpot; the agent checks the customer's open AR balance in QuickBooks against their credit limit and either releases the order to fulfillment or holds it and notifies the account owner and finance.
rule_hooks: customer credit limits, AR aging

scenario: A new e-commerce order arrives with a shipping address flagged undeliverable by the carrier API; the agent moves the order to an exceptions status, emails the customer for a corrected address, and logs it in the fulfillment tracker.
rule_hooks: address validation result codes, exception SLA

scenario: An order is placed for a SKU marked dropship in the product catalog; the agent creates a PO to the designated dropship supplier, emails them the ship-to details, and updates the order with the supplier's expected ship date.
rule_hooks: SKU fulfillment method, supplier mapping

scenario: A regional warehouse posts in Slack that a SKU is out of stock; the agent checks other locations' on-hand quantities against their safety stock and, if one has surplus, creates a transfer order and notifies both warehouse leads.
rule_hooks: safety stock per location, transfer eligibility

scenario: A receiving clerk logs a shipment received damaged with photos in the helpdesk; the agent checks the claim filing deadline for that carrier, files the claim details in the claims tracker, emails the carrier, and notifies the purchasing contact.
rule_hooks: carrier claim deadlines, liability limits

scenario: A customer opens a Zendesk ticket saying an order marked delivered never arrived; the agent pulls the carrier POD, and if signature or GPS is missing per policy, files a carrier trace, ships a replacement, and updates the ticket.
rule_hooks: POD requirements, reship value threshold

scenario: A landlord emails the annual CAM reconciliation; the agent compares the billed amount against the lease's CAM cap in the lease abstract sheet, flags overages, and creates a review task for the facilities manager with the variance.
rule_hooks: lease abstract, CAM cap percentage

scenario: A manager submits a desk move request for their team; the agent checks the floor seating chart for open desks in the requested zone, reserves them, files IT and facilities tickets for the move date, and emails the affected employees.
rule_hooks: seating chart, move lead time

scenario: A fire marshal's inspection report is emailed with deficiencies; the agent logs each item in the compliance tracker with the statutory correction deadline, dispatches work orders to the contracted vendor, and calendars the reinspection.
rule_hooks: deficiency correction deadlines, contracted vendors

scenario: A monthly utility bill arrives for a site; the agent compares usage to the trailing 12-month average in the energy sheet and, if it exceeds the variance threshold, opens a facilities investigation ticket and holds the bill for approval.
rule_hooks: usage baseline, variance percentage

scenario: A host books a visitor in the visitor management calendar for a lab area; the agent checks whether a signed NDA exists for the visitor's company, sends one via DocuSign if missing, and notifies the host and front desk of the status.
rule_hooks: restricted areas requiring NDA, NDA registry

scenario: An employee requests a parking permit via a form; the agent checks the permit inventory and eligibility list (seniority, carpool, accessibility), assigns a spot or waitlists the request, and updates facilities and the employee.
rule_hooks: parking eligibility priority, permit capacity

scenario: A loaner laptop's checkout period lapses per the IT asset sheet; the agent emails the borrower and their manager, extends once if allowed by policy, and otherwise opens a recovery ticket and flags the asset.
rule_hooks: loaner duration, extension limit

scenario: A Freshdesk ticket reports an MFA lockout; the agent verifies the requester against the HR directory and manager-approval rule, and if verified, logs the reset request to IT with priority by role and replies with next steps.
rule_hooks: identity verification steps, privileged role list

scenario: A monitoring email reports an SSL certificate expiring in 21 days; the agent looks up the owning team and registrar in the IT asset register, opens a renewal ticket, and escalates to the IT manager if under 7 days with no assignee.
rule_hooks: renewal lead time, asset ownership

scenario: An employee requests access to a shared mailbox in Slack; the agent checks the mailbox owner listed in the access register, requests owner approval, and on approval creates the IT provisioning ticket and logs the grant.
rule_hooks: resource owner approval, access register

scenario: A team submits a request to adopt a new SaaS tool; the agent checks the vendor's data classification against the security-review policy, opens a security questionnaire task if required, and holds the procurement request until it clears.
rule_hooks: data classification tiers, review requirements

scenario: A managed printer emails a low-toner alert; the agent maps the device to its model and cartridge SKU, checks the supply cabinet stock sheet, and either assigns a stocked cartridge to facilities or places an order with the office supply vendor.
rule_hooks: device-to-SKU mapping, cabinet stock

scenario: A project manager files a change request in the project tool adding scope; the agent reads the estimated cost and schedule impact, routes it to the sponsor or steering committee per the change-control thresholds, and updates the project RAID log.
rule_hooks: change control thresholds, approver matrix

scenario: A task assignment in Asana pushes a team member over 100% allocation in the capacity sheet; the agent flags it to the resource manager, suggests an available person with the same skill tag, and comments on the task.
rule_hooks: capacity limits, skill matrix

scenario: A contractor submits a weekly timesheet; the agent adds the hours to the PO burn tracker and, when cumulative spend crosses 80% of the PO value, notifies the project owner and procurement to extend or wind down.
rule_hooks: PO ceiling, burn alert threshold

scenario: A contractor's engagement end date in the vendor workforce sheet is 14 days out; the agent asks the hiring manager whether to extend, and on no response or a decline, schedules access removal and equipment return tasks.
rule_hooks: engagement term, co-employment max tenure

scenario: A recruiter moves a candidate to onsite stage in the ATS; the agent reads the required panel roles, finds a common slot in interviewers' calendars, books the room and Zoom, and sends confirmations to candidate and panel.
rule_hooks: panel composition by role level, scheduling windows

scenario: An engineer requests an on-call swap in Slack; the agent checks the rotation sheet for the counterpart's consent and rest-period rules, updates the schedule and paging tool calendar, and announces the change in the team channel.
rule_hooks: minimum rest between shifts, consent requirement

scenario: A state air-quality permit in the compliance register hits 90 days to expiry; the agent assigns the renewal to the EHS owner, creates a document-collection checklist from the permit type, and calendars the filing deadline.
rule_hooks: permit renewal lead times, required documents by permit type

scenario: A new component supplier is added to the vendor master; the agent checks if their parts fall in a 3TG-relevant category, sends the CMRT survey via email, and logs the due date in the compliance tracker.
rule_hooks: material categories requiring CMRT, response deadline

scenario: A sales order for an international customer is created; the agent looks up each SKU's ECCN and the destination country in the export matrix, holds orders needing a license, and notifies trade compliance with the details.
rule_hooks: ECCN-by-country license matrix

scenario: An employee's forklift certification lapses in the training records sheet; the agent removes them from forklift assignments in the shift schedule, enrolls them in the next class, and notifies their supervisor.
rule_hooks: certification validity, role-required certs

scenario: An external auditor emails a PBC request list; the agent maps each item to the control owner from the controls matrix, creates tasks with the auditor's due date, and shares a tracking sheet with the audit liaison.
rule_hooks: controls ownership matrix, PBC due dates

scenario: An all-hands event RSVP form closes; the agent tallies headcount and dietary restrictions, compares to the catering vendor's minimums and per-head budget, places or adjusts the order, and confirms with the event owner.
rule_hooks: catering per-head budget, vendor order minimums

scenario: The mailroom logs an inbound package for an employee; the agent emails and Slacks the recipient, and if unclaimed after 5 business days or marked perishable/sensitive, escalates to their manager or returns to sender per policy.
rule_hooks: pickup holding period, package handling class
